limitations: Dynamic pool and gauge instances are volatile deployment state and are not accepted Contract identities by appearing here.
No official current Quoter deployment was established.
The accepted CL registry roots create no route or writer support.

architectures.positionType: fungible ERC-20 LP balance and total supply

mechanisms.volatile: Constant-product invariant over raw reserves: reserve0 * reserve1, with the factory-selected volatile fee applied by the deployed pool.
mechanisms.stable: Aerodrome-style stable invariant after normalizing each reserve to 18 decimals: a = x*y/1e18; b = x*x/1e18 + y*y/1e18; k = a*b/1e18. Stable and volatile pools with the same token pair remain distinct identities.
mechanisms.reserves: Pool getReserves returns reserves in token0/token1 order. Router getReserves and quote methods are convenience reads, not an authorization or freshness proof.
mechanisms.liquidity: LP totalSupply and a wallet LP balance describe fungible positions; neither is interchangeable with either reserve or with a CL liquidity scalar.

discovery.rule: Sort nonidentical token addresses, preserve the stable flag, resolve getPool(token0, token1, stable), and require factory.isPool(result) at the same block. allPools/PoolCreated may enumerate candidates but do not replace the mapping check.
discovery.staleRowRule: An analytics or cached row is display evidence only until the current factory mapping, bytecode, tokens, stable flag, and intended network are revalidated.

architectures.positionType: ERC-721 position whose record owns a tick range and uint128 liquidity

mechanisms.price: slot0.sqrtPriceX96 is Q64.96 sqrt(token1/token0); slot0.tick is the greatest tick whose ratio does not exceed the current ratio.
mechanisms.range: A position has tickLower and tickUpper aligned to the pool tick spacing. Pool active liquidity counts liquidity active at the current tick, not all position liquidity.
mechanisms.fees: Factory tickSpacingToFee supplies a default swap fee and fee modules may override current pool fees. Read the deployed pool/factory at the target block rather than treating documentation tables as immutable constants.
mechanisms.oracle: Pool observations are time-indexed cumulative state. They require cardinality/age validation and are not an automatic safe quote.

discovery.poolRule: Sort nonidentical tokens, validate enabled tick spacing, resolve factory.getPool(token0, token1, tickSpacing), and require factory.isPool(result) plus matching pool factory/token0/token1/tickSpacing reads at one block.
discovery.gaugeRule: Read pool.gauge as optional. For a nonzero gauge require CLGaugeFactory.isGauge, matching gauge pool/NFT/tokens/tickSpacing, and current incentives-voter liveness before relying on it.
discovery.quoterBoundary: No current official Quoter coordinate was found. Do not substitute a guessed upstream address; future quote support must add a separately evidenced root or use exact read-only simulation/math with explicit limitations.

nonNormalizationRules: A basic stable flag is not a CL tick spacing.
A basic LP token amount is not CL uint128 liquidity.
A CL pool's liquidity read is not reserves, wallet position liquidity, or gauge staked liquidity.
A factory-discovered instance is not a supported route until its current mapping and operation preconditions are validated.
